title: How GrokBot Solves the AI Agent Cold Start
description:
One thing I keep thinking about with these AI agents...

The more stuff you plug into them, the more useful they get.

Your Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, calendar, customer calls, CRM...

All of a sudden, you can just ask questions and pull information from across your entire business.

Pretty powerful.

You just probably don't want to give the thing the keys to the whole company 😂
